text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
(Not yet... It's too early to make a move...
Save my legs, gauge the distance for the decisive strike—)

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
――!!
Right here! HAAAAAAAH!!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: My King, how was it?
choice_data_list: Amazing...! Your sharpness has leveled up significantly.
Amazing...! Your sharpness has leveled up significantly!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much! I believe this is all
thanks to learning not to rush for victory.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Now that I've reached this state of mind, I feel I can live up to your expectations in the NHK Mile Cup!"
choice_data_list: Yeah, you can definitely do it!
Yeah, I know you can do it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Only a little time left until the main event.
Among the Umamusume who have declared their entry, there are no notably formidable rivals.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "With sharpness like this, Durandal will surely achieve great results."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, I shall do it.
Though no one has noticed your greatness yet—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"At the NHK Mile Cup, I will make everyone recognize it beyond doubt.
That you are the King..."

Nay, the one who shall be King is Sir Durandal!
Thine own self!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: You're... !?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Nya-ha-ha! It's a coup, a total revolution!
There's no point in quietly playing second fiddle to anyone!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Becoming a commander in one's own right sounds like an amusing prospect, too, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The one who appeared was No Reason, an Umamusume like a Sengoku warlord who, in the recent Satsuki Sho—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her flashy moves drove the fans wild.
She's a self-made Umamusume, a true standout of her generation.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
An uprising against superiors...?
I cannot let that comment slide.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: That notion contradicts the chivalry I believe in. I cannot accept it.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Oho? It seems we must have
ourselves a little question-and-answer session.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Follow me, Sir Durandal.
Allow me to gauge the true nature of your resolve.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Bring it on.
Excuse me, then, my King.
choice_data_list: Yeah, just make sure you don't pick a fight.
Yeah, make sure not to fight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The two of them, with their differing philosophies, headed off somewhere to clash over their beliefs.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Mm, this place should do.
Let us have a proper chat.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Listen well, Lord Durandal.
Here is what I am thinking.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
If you aim to conquer the Twinkle Series—
becoming someone's vassal is utterly laughable!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Why would that be?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
It goes without saying.
If one entrusts their way of life to others...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: If that other person strays from the path, we go down together, after all.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
I am an Umamusume. One ought to burn their life away
for the very path they believe in.
Just as those in history once did...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The warlords who unified the realm
were all masters of their own castles and domains.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
No samurai or ninja serving a master
has ever claimed the realm. Not once.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
In other words, remaining subservient to someone
is nothing less than "abandoning your claim to the realm"!

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, while I may join hands with someone,
I shall never submit beneath them.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Well now? Did you not feel something,
or have some thoughts on the matter?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: What are your convictions? If you have given them no deep thought, then renounce your knighthood at once and...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No, even so, I—
will never cease to be a knight.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Ho-hoh, and why is that? Speak your mind.
What is your reasoning?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
There is only one reason.
To live in service to my King... no, to that person—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Because to me, that is the greatest bliss.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
The ultimate... bliss?
Devoting oneself...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "Yes. All who are born into this world should aspire to be the highest of all: a King..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
While that may be a sound argument,
isn't it also a bit unreasonable?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Neither Umamusume nor humans
are all born with the caliber of a king.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
“If I can live as a king, I would gladly perish.”
There are only a select few who can think that way.
If that is so—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To seek and serve the one King I can believe in.
To support that King, and fulfill our dream together...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: Isn't it fine for a path like that to exist? That, too, is... the path we choose to live.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: No Reason-san, do you find supreme bliss along your own path?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it sends shivers down my spine!
Just imagining defeating higher-ranked Umamusume
and turning the whole world upside down!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I see. It makes me shudder with excitement as well.
To seat our king upon the supreme throne, and then—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"A knight who was never supposed to take the realm
conquers the Twinkle Series."
When I think about that...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Y-You...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"When that is accomplished, everyone will surely realize:
'Even if you cannot be king, finding someone to believe in can lead you to glory.'"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
To prove that—
I shall remain a knight.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: I see... To conquer the Twinkle Series while remaining a knight, huh...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Nyah-ha-ha-ha! Revolution!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
That, too, would be an overthrowing of the old order.
After all, no one has ever managed
to achieve such a feat before...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Because it is thou who seeketh to accomplish it for the first time.
That too shall turn the world on its head.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: "...You're right. I am not here to overthrow the kingdom or dethrone the King..."

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"I intend to rewrite history and astonish the world.
—As a knight."

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Oho, say whatever you wish. First, prove it in your next run at the 'NHK Mile Cup'.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
Though considering the Umamusume scheduled to run...
we might be the ones getting a painful lesson instead.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Huh... A rough time?
Isn't there some kind of mistake?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
From what I've heard,
there shouldn't be any formidable opponents this year...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: Well, from a conventional standpoint, it may seem that way. But never, ever forget.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
A cunning hero always charges down unexpected cliffs
and launches a surprise assault.

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
She will most likely enter the NHK Mile Cup.
My sworn rival, that is.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: No Reason-san's archrival? That would be...

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text:
At times, I call that fellow like so.
Indeed—

text_block_list.name: No Reason
text_block_list.text: The “Demon King of the Sixth Heaven”! When it comes to surprise attacks, no one surpasses him. You'd best be on your guard.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—"The Demon King of the Sixth Heaven."
Just who that was referring to became clear in the TV press conference.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Now, let it be revealed here.
The path guided by the celestial sphere.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
From the Satsuki Sho to the Japanese Derby.
Simply walking the Classic Triple Crown path isn't enough.

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"Deficiency, depletion—yes, it is not enough.
At this rate, my reincarnation into myself will not come to pass.
If that is so—"

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Kuh-kuh-kuh, then let us descend.
Into that very threshold—the NHK Mile Cup!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
"From the NHK Mile Cup to the Japanese Derby.
This is the forbidden 'MC Rotation'!
Let us burn away the old paths and conventional wisdom alike."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
What?! You just ran the Satsuki Sho,
and you're saying you're going to run
both the NHK Mile Cup AND the Tokyo Yushun right after?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
It's madness...
Yet, if it's her—the one called the strongest
on the Classic Triple Crown road this season...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
No way...!!
Running in the NHK Mile Cup on top of the two Spring Classic Triple Crown races...?

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Trainer-dono, is such a grueling march
even possible?
choice_data_list: It's possible, but... that's quite reckless.
It's possible, but... that's quite reckless.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, last year there was also an Umamusume
who went from the NHK Mile Cup to the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby)...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, when it comes to the Satsuki Sho,
it's already completely beyond standard.
No ordinary Umamusume could ever pull it off, but...

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
Still... she's actually trying to do it. She really is capable of it,
that Tanino Gimlet.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: The Umamusume rumored to be the strongest among the Classic Triple Crown contenders. Her power is truly—

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The Demon King of the Sixth Heaven! A fallen angel descended
from the divine realm to rule over the underworld itself.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
She is undeniably an Umamusume of the highest caliber...
Everything we have built up until now will surely be put to the test in this race.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
I... am a knight. Whether I can do it
or not, I must simply—obey orders.

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: If you command it, I shall surely bring this "Holy Sword" down upon the fallen angel.
choice_data_list: Alright, here we go! The NHK Mile Cup!
Alright, let's do it! The NHK Mile Cup!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text: —Understood!

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
"Tanino Gimlet...
Those pitch-black wings that tear through any distance
are a true threat. However――"

text_block_list.name: Durandal
text_block_list.text:
The mile is our sanctuary!
We won't surrender it so easily!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The NHK Mile Cup was supposed to be smooth sailing.
Until the Demon Prince made an unexpected invasion.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the spring of the Classic year,
the ultimate battle of Holy vs. Demonic begins!
